Unlinks the specified external identity-provider account from the selected cPanel account. The required PHP argument provider is encoded as provider_id, correcting the pinned provider wire name. subjectUniqueIdentifier accepts int|string; identifiers are forwarded unchanged without numeric conversion, truncation or assumptions about provider-specific formats. Oversized identifiers must be strings.

This mutation uses form POST. The source declares no rollback; the client performs no automatic retry or rollback. The result is a nullable object without pinned fields: preserve opaque object fields and explicit null, and reject an absent data member.
